title: IoTKit MQTT Output Adapter v1 publication fixture
description: One MQTT publication as IoTKit emits it. payload is the exact byte string; an empty string is a zero-length payload. Producer conformance compares topic, qos, retain, and payload bytes. Consumer conformance parses payload as JSON and must not depend on key order or whitespace.

kind.description: Required for observation fixtures; the kind-key segment of the topic.

status_form.description: Required for status fixtures; selects the status.schema.json definition.

consumer_note.description: What a consumer must do with this publication.
